text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin has made it through the 
all-important first three years of her
career and
left her mark on the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay, Trainer... Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um... Could you say that one more time,
please?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is trying to work up the
courage to
order coffee from a fancy
cafe all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But... just look at the cafe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They haven't got a sign and there are
plants
grow'n everywhere... How'm I
s'posed to know
where the entrance is?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No one's going in or out either. Oh,
gosh, don't
tell me I gotta know the
password t'enter!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What if they toss me out 'cause they
don't want a
country bumpkin like me in
their shop?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: You've gotten closer to being a 'c...
You've gotten closer to being a 'c...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well... I have been giv'n it my all, at the very least...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All righty. No more dilly-dally'n! Here I
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, Yukino Bijin heads off...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I did it. Easy-peasy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There was only one staff member, but she was a real city girl! Just chocked full of glitz 'n glam!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She had a nice big smile and explained
everyth'n
on the menu for me so
patiently.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She even knew who I was! She wished me
good
luck in my races!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: From the heart, huh...
choice_data_list: They really welcomed you with open...
They really welcomed you with open...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! You're right! Down the hatch!
choice_data_list: I went ahead and bought it, so go ...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...I guess it takes heart t'be fancy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I've always admired how fancy and
put-together
everyth'n from the city is.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I used to think there was no way I'd ever
be like
city folks. It was like they were
from a whole
nother world...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But the thing that really matters deep
down is
your heart. Behind all that glitz
and glam, there's
still a person, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A person just the same as me and the
folks back
home. The only difference is
whether you wanna
be hip or not.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A city girl's not a city girl because
she's
stylish.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
She's a city girl because she has a
stylish
heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Yukino Bijin has gained a
slightly deeper
understanding of what
being a city girl really
means.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've gotten a li'l closer to
find'n my own
glitz and glam!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It won't be long now!
